'''Ernst Wolfgang Hamburger'''  (8 June 1933 – 4 July 2018) was a [[Germany|German]]-born [[Brazil]]ian [[physicist]] and [[popular science|popularizer of science]]. Hamburger was internationally known for his activities regarding [[Public awareness of science|public understanding of science]]. He was the director of {{interlanguage link|Estação Ciência|pt|Estação Ciência da Universidade de São Paulo}}, an interactive [[science museum]] in [[São Paulo]]. He won the [[UNESCO]] [[Kalinga Prize]] for the Popularization of Science,<ref name="unesco">{{cite web|url=http://www.unesco.org/bpi/eng/unescopress/2001/01-08e.shtml|title=Kalinga Prize for the Popularization of Science|date=19 January 2001|work=UNESCO press|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20121012202844/http://www.unesco.org/bpi/eng/unescopress/2001/01-08e.shtml|archivedate=12 October 2012}}</ref> the [[José Reis Award for the Divulgation of Science]], the medal of the [[Brazilian Order of Scientific Merit]], and was a member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]].

== Biography ==
Born in Berlin on 8 June 1933, Hamburger fled from the Nazis with his parents to Brazil when he was three years old.<ref>[http://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/en/2014/02/27/ernst-hamburger-courageous-sao-paulo-citizen Ernst Hamburger: A courageous São Paulo citizen] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180705204212/http://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/en/2014/02/27/ernst-hamburger-courageous-sao-paulo-citizen/ |date=2018-07-05 }}, ''Pesquisa [[FAPESP]]'' magazine, Jan.2014, Ed.215</ref> He studied [[physics]] at the [[University of São Paulo]] and joined its faculty (Institute of Physics) soon after his graduation, in 1960, and retired  as a full professor of physics. Hamburger was married to {{interlanguage link|Amélia Hamburger|de||es|Amélia Império de Hamburger|pt}} (d. 2011), also a physicist and colleague at the university. They had five children. One of them, [[Cao Hamburger]], is a film and TV director and scriptwriter.

Hamburger died on 4 July 2018, in São Paulo, of [[lymphoma]],<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/ciencia/2018/07/morre-aos-85-o-fisico-e-professor-da-usp-ernst-hamburger-em-sao-paulo.shtml|title=Morre, aos 85, o físico e professor da USP Ernst Hamburger, em São Paulo|date=2018-07-05|work=Folha de S.Paulo|access-date=2018-07-05|language=pt-BR}}</ref> at the age of 85.
